overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 of the last 3 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads (the filed values through FY2022 came via PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, $18.967M in FY2022); the filer's own cash-flow statement reports this capex line for all three missing years. The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period; against the same statement's true per-year values it overstates FY2023 capex by $44.503M (true $15.028M) and FY2024 capex by $29.835M (true $29.696M) — both in the conservative direction of lowering owner's earnings. The value is 3.14x the last filed capex value ($18.967M, FY2022), inside the engine's 0.1x-10x band.
